text:
Aisha (AE): hey team — looping you in for the Seraphim POC. Customer wants to validate a new variant (seraphim-30b-llama-compat) with 8-bit quant and KV cache across sessions. Main asks: catalog fit, timeline for onboarding, pricing for Dedicated + burst, and security Qs. Any immediate blockers?

Ben (Solutions Eng): Can we support 8-bit quant for that arch? We have quantv2 path but need to confirm artifact compatibility. tagging @Ravi for model ops details.

Ravi (ML Eng): We can do 8-bit quant, but need model weights + tokenizer + config. If they use custom RMSNorm variants or fused ops, we might need adapter or compile custom kernels. KV cache across sessions is fine but requires sticky routing + state store config. Rough perf: on p4d-equivalent, seraphim-30b-quantv2 ~40-50 tok/s depending on seq len.

Olivia (Infra Eng): Dedicated pool ok; bursts limited by capacity. For pricing: reserved commit + burst hourly rate. For a POC we can offer a 2-week reserved slot with hosted fallback. I'll check quota.

Marcus (Sales - Seraphim): Customer requires VPC/private deployment due to PHI. Security Q: they ask about customer-managed KMS, audit logs, and data residency. Also need pricing estimate to justify PoC.

Eve (Security): We support customer-managed KMS for Private and produce audit logs. Please complete our security questionnaire (SQQ) so I can attach artifacts (SOC2, pen test). SQQ link: https://redwood-internal/sales/sqq/seraphim. Also need a model dataflow diagram before Private deploy.

Ben (Solutions Eng): On compatibility: does their variant use any custom operators or is it a standard HF/Torch model? If they provide an ONNX or TorchScript artifact that's best. If not, adapter layer is possible but adds validation time.

Aisha (AE): Timeline target from customer is ~3 weeks to a working POC. If custom ops are needed, will that blow the timeline? They also asked if we can cover 100k tokens/day for 2 weeks in trial credits — any flexibility?

Ravi (ML Eng): Adapter path (no custom op compile) typically 3–5 days dev + accuracy/regression checks. Custom op compilation and kernel tuning could be ~10–14 days depending on ops. Recommend parallel approach: spin up hosted quant variant to validate quality while infra/security prepare Private deployment.

Olivia (Infra Eng): We can reserve infra slot but need NDA + PO for Private. For trial credits, I can authorize up to $5k for the POC; anything above requires RevOps approval. I'll DM billing contacts.

Marcus (Sales - Seraphim): I'll get NDA and push the SQQ CSV from the customer into Eve. Also confirming they can provide a Torch state_dict or HF repo.

Eve (Security): Great — I'll prefill SQQ answers and reconcile with their CSV. Also need to know where they plan to store KV cache (our managed store vs their VPC store) and how keys are provisioned.

Ben (Solutions Eng): Example hosted config to validate quickly: ```json
{"model":"seraphim-30b-quantv2","batch_size":8,"max_tokens":2048,"kv_cache":true}
``` Use that for perf/quality runs.

Aisha (AE): action items: Marcus — confirm VPC + NDA by EOD; Olivia — approve $5k trial credit; Ravi — start adapter feasibility (3 days); Eve — start SQQ prefill and attach SOC2 docs. I'll produce a one-pager for the customer and share.

Olivia (Infra Eng): noted. created internal ticket INF-5423 to schedule the private deploy slot and track billing.

deploybot: Ticket INF-5423 created by Olivia for Seraphim POC private deploy scheduling.

Aisha (AE): thanks all — I'll follow up with calendar invites and the one-pager. if anything blocks, ping here. :thumbsup:
